geometry_stats.fitted_on: all coordinate training valid nodes only
geometry_stats.statistics_input: cached float32 geometry converted to float64
geometry_stats.neighbor_policy: exclude self/padding; include all kth-distance ties; use all when fewer than k

lr.rule: successful-update warmup then cosine, independent of VAL

checkpoint_rule: strict minimum full VAL macro_vs_sbs_pct with common new81000 TRAIN-fitted SBS; first wins ties
inference_rule: eval mode; input-only32/8 graph hierarchy; original score MLP/pair differences/maximin; stable ascending-global-solver-ID tie break
source_plan: common seed2 full18 natural stream; exact1024 rows, shuffled tails carried across cycles
gradients: per-graph means weighted by actual micro rows / logical1024; both dropout forwards; one clip/step
train_eval: full TRAIN every5 VAL points plus the selected best if absent
test: one full TEST after unique VAL-best lock; saved predictions reusable
test_rnd_disclosure: TEST informed earlier R&D; preserved old holdouts plus previously unused input-stratified extensions
nss_reference: locked R79 weights, fresh predictions on the same new4500 TEST; no NSS retraining

A.mechanism: input-only hard32/8 hierarchical directed graph encoder

C.mechanism: full18 GPU CatBoost native-winner classification bank

D.mechanism: full18 GPU CatBoost legal-pool relative-regret MultiRMSE bank

record.candidate_policy: unchanged frozen NEW90k release: B filtering; MOEL renamed reld_mt; never restore MTL
record.selection: strict minimum full18 VAL macro_vs_sbs_pct; TRAIN-fitted SBS; first ties
record.tree_selection: one common tree count across all18 task models; no per-task best assembly
record.test_policy: unique VAL lock before TEST and LIB; TEST is development-exposed, not a new blind holdout
record.acceptance: full18 Top1 strictly higher and mean_cost/actual_regret nonincreasing on VAL; report same-lock TEST/LIB and fixed target36 recovery/false picks; no zero-count-only success
record.evidence_boundary: A/B coarsening control includes fixed B structural regularizers. C/D are independent model-family experiments with boosting budgets, not matched neural compute. Not full original DiffPool or ordered CatBoost reproduction.

objective.main: original R77 CE/comparison/risk plus original symmetric R-Drop

hierarchy_auxiliary.target: input relations and assignment entropy only; no routes or performance labels

historical_reference.evidence: historical same-data reference, not equal-parameter/equal-compute control

evidence_boundary: A hard versus B learned graph coarsening; B includes fixed input-only link/entropy regularization. Not an exact DiffPool reproduction.
